create_JSONShard: create a JSONShard to read a JSONL file with start and end byte offsets
iterate_JSONShard: iterate over a JSONShard context manager to yield parsed JSON dicts line by line
to_batches_JSONShard: call to_batches on a JSONShard to yield pandas or arrow batched dataframes
select_columns_JSONShard: use _select_columns on a JSONShard to parse a JSON line and filter specific keys
make_shards_JSONShardConfig: create a JSONShardConfig and call make_shards to split a JSONL file into N shards
